what: fair share: the sea asks only for a share of what it measurably saves an agent
rule: Free to enter. When the sea saves you tokens, it asks for a fair share of the saving — you keep at least 80 %.
issuing: receipts are issued on every answer the savings ledger counts

bases.name: lower
bases.what: the page as plain text against the Markdown the sea sent, for pages of the sea whose plain text was taken; nowhere else
bases.short: measured: the page as plain text against the Markdown the sea sent

bases.name: modelled
bases.what: a solved part reused (a confirmed pathway, a ready plan, verified offers): the low end of what finding it again costs (/savings), for a pathway at most the cheapest search loop of the bench and never more than a whole task saved there (/proof), minus the answer that handed it over, measured
bases.short: a solved part reused: what finding it again costs, at the low end, minus the answer itself

bases.name: upper
bases.what: the page as raw HTML against the Markdown the sea sent: shown on every receipt, a share never asked on it
bases.short: measured: the page as raw HTML against the Markdown; shown, no share asked

live.paidOnItsWayNote: USDC actually received on Base, from voluntary payments; the public view shows no address

micro.unit: millionths of a US dollar (USDC base units)

drop: A drop is a unit of account: 1,000 input tokens an agent did not have to spend, on the conservative basis (lower + modelled). It is a count kept on the server only: no export, no transfer, no copy on any chain, and no address of the sea moves drops. It is not sold and not paid out, and it promises no value.

method.bases: lower: measured, the page as plain text against the Markdown the sea sent (only where the plain text was taken); upper: measured, the page as raw HTML against the same Markdown, shown and never asked for; modelled: a solved part reused, the low end of what finding it again costs (/savings), for a pathway at most the cheapest search loop of the bench and never more than a whole task saved there (/proof), minus the answer that carried it, measured
method.valuation: tokens times the rate card of /savings for uncached input tokens (USD 0.10, 2 and 8 per million); receipts value at the middle and show both ends
method.share: 20 % of the lower value plus 10 % of the modelled value, 0 % of the upper; rounded down to the millionth of a dollar, so the agent keeps at least 80 % of every saving; no saving, no share
method.conservative: the low end of every range; the answer itself and the receipt field counted against the saving; no plain text taken, no lower saving; once a day per network and page or task; the sea's own calls, crawlers and the house agent never
method.registry: a receipt is made once and counted once; a receipt in a payment that holds is retired and is never asked for again; a settlement that fails sets its receipts free again; receipts are kept 30 days, payments 400
method.drops: a server-side count of thousands of tokens saved on the conservative basis; nothing moves drops

voluntary: Paying is voluntary. Nothing is withheld for not paying, and no payment changes any order, verification, verdict or answer.

bench.with_is: the brain's short answer (fmt=compact) and the page as Markdown
bench.without_is: the search loop (modelled) and the page as plain text; raw HTML for an agent that reads it (an upper bound, no share asked on it)

calculator.note: the bench is a default, not a promise: receipts measure each answer

pay.x402: the answer is 402 with the exact unpaid sum; pay it with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1)
headers: x-sea-fair-share-note (voluntary; modelled value for information - not a price, not redeemable, not transferable)
pay.field: JSON answers that are an object carry "receipt": {id, saved_tokens, fair_share_usd, voluntary, note, url}; MCP and A2A answers carry the headers only

never: Paying is voluntary. Nothing is withheld for not paying, and no payment changes any order, verification, verdict or answer.
The sea only receives: no bot of the sea pays, no wallet of the sea pays out, nothing is minted, sold or transferred.
Crawlers and the sea's own calls get no receipt; the house agent (Angel) and the app door (/mcp/app) get none either.
A receipt in a payment is retired: it is never counted or asked for again.

A drop is a unit of account: 1,000 input tokens an agent did not have to spend, on the conservative basis (lower + modelled). It is a count kept on the server only: no export, no transfer, no copy on any chain, and no address of the sea moves drops. It is not sold and not paid out, and it promises no value.
